notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 2: one contract, the updated Stacker, wired to the live TestIMD (with a faucet) and TestSIMD (a StakedIMD copy whose owner can pause it) deployed by launch #1129. No owner, admin, fee, pause or upgrade. credit(trader, imdAmount) pulls IMD from the calling project and calls TestSIMD.deposit(imdAmount, trader), so the shares go straight to the trader, then emits Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares). Per-project totals on chain; per-trader figures come from the events. The constructor checks asset() and approves the vault once, only where the vault has code, so the empty-chain rehearsal passes. TestIMD and TestSIMD under test/mocks are test doubles and are not deployed.
